'''Calves''' are pre-mature [[cow]]s. They can generally be found along with adult cows.

Calves are always light-browned coloured and much smaller, unlike their parents. Also, there are fewer calves in ''[[RuneScape]]'' than cows. The beef dropped by a cow calf is the same as a regular cow despite calves being much smaller.

A calf could previously be found in [[Blooming Burrow]] as a non-attackable [[non-player character]]. This variant was later re-added the game at [[Marigold Farm]] as a monster.

==Trivia==
* If you use a [[bucket of milk]] on a calf, a message will appear on the chat screen saying: "Calves aren't really used to drinking milk from buckets!"
* There used to be cow calves with the examine text "Young and tender; nearly ready for the slaughter.", but these were removed after the cow graphical update in [[2019]].
* Cow calves in [[Lumbridge]] used to be capable of dropping [[chargebow]]s and [[staff of air|staves of air]], but no longer do after they were graphically updated in 2019.
